name: Philip Meng
milestone_by_age_26: Accepted to YC S26 as CEO of Shepherd while a high school senior, receiving $500K in funding.
starting_point: Born around 2007; grew up in Hong Kong and attended Chinese International School before moving to Phillips Academy Andover.
current_position: Co-founder & CEO of Shepherd (YC S26), based in San Francisco.

trajectory.title: Started Minecraft YouTube channel
trajectory.description: Began editing and posting Minecraft videos during COVID, generating over $9,000 in ad revenue and partnerships with well-known YouTubers.

trajectory.title: Attended Phillips Academy Andover
trajectory.description: Enrolled at the prestigious boarding school in Massachusetts, where he would later co-found Launchpad.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Launchpad
trajectory.description: Built a global startup incubator for high schoolers with 37 chapters across 8 countries and 9 states.

trajectory.title: Launched podcast and founder profiles
trajectory.description: Interviewed 20+ CEOs and wrote 123 founder profiles, generating 17.7M views and 14K followers.

trajectory.title: Interned at Animoca Brands and 645 Ventures
trajectory.description: Gained M&A and venture capital experience, working alongside 645 Ventures co-founder Nnamdi Okike.

trajectory.title: Co-founded Shepherd
trajectory.description: Built an AI startup with co-founders Ishan Ramrakhiani and a third teammate.

trajectory.title: Accepted to YC S26 with $500K funding
trajectory.description: Got into Y Combinator's S26 batch as a high school senior, choosing to build Shepherd instead of attending Stanford or Harvard.

name: Ishan Ramrakhiani
milestone_by_age_26: Accepted to YC S26 as CPO of Shepherd while a high school senior, receiving $500K in funding.
starting_point: Born around 2007; grew up in Fort Wayne, Indiana, attending Canterbury School before being named a U.S. Presidential Scholars semi-finalist.
current_position: Co-founder & CPO of Shepherd (YC S26), based in San Francisco.

trajectory.title: Started coding and building projects
trajectory.description: Joined GitHub and began building tools, exploring machine learning and computational biology.

trajectory.title: Built research mentor matching tool
trajectory.description: Created a tool to help students find research mentors that grew to 60,000 users.

trajectory.title: Research intern at Purdue and IU Indianapolis
trajectory.description: Worked in labs exploring breath sensors for disease detection and molecular models for drug discovery.

trajectory.title: Research intern at Dartmouth Health
trajectory.description: Worked at Levy Lab on virtual RNA inference models and computational biology research.

trajectory.title: Built AI video editing agent
trajectory.description: Developed an AI video editing agent inside Adobe After Effects.

trajectory.title: Software intern at Cepstrum
trajectory.description: Worked on cursor for network engineering at the AI startup.

trajectory.title: Accepted to YC S26 with $500K funding
trajectory.description: Co-founded Shepherd with Philip Meng, got into YC S26, choosing to build instead of attending Stanford.
